Hello everyone!

I’m back! Here’s this weekend’s comic - I hope you enjoy it.

If you’d like to follow my work, get more updates, or send me suggestions for future translations, you can find me here:

👉 Patreon: https://patreon.com/comiccx

👉 Website: https://comic.cx/

On the website, you can have access to exclusive free translations and there are already 70 translated comics available there, including around 50 more translations than the ones I post publicly for free.

About My Releases
I usually post 1 free translation every Saturday on e-hentai, and around 3 to 7 new translations each week on Patreon and the website.
